Speaking to reporters in the Oval Office, Trump compared Iran to other wars by length and U.S. casualties — pointing out that 18 Americans have been killed there compared to “tens of thousands of people” in other conflicts. Trump’s categorization came a day after Vice President JD Vance said that he would not describe the conflict with Iran as a war.
